entries.style_notes: A mixed convention: flowing or clipped infernal-inspired personal names, ordinary names inherited from surrounding communities, and chosen concept names shared across genders. Family names are optional and no sound or virtue implies allegiance or morality.

D&D establishes a returning undead being, not a single ethnic naming convention or a universal revenge title.
